title: How do delayed outcomes become valid monitoring evidence?
scope: Declared schematic decision D7, group G, prediction positive; delayed outcome negative. Event identities illustrate joins, not measured fairness or a production data policy.

steps.label: Serve decision D7
steps.description: Access control and minimization precede inference. D7 returns without waiting for an outcome or governance update.

steps.label: Prediction-only evidence
steps.description: Parity monitoring can consume the recorded decision and group. Label-dependent error metrics cannot count an unknown outcome.
cards: Parity input ready · error metric pending

steps.label: Outcome arrives out of order
steps.description: An outcome for D8 cannot label D7. Hold each outcome by decision ID; timing proximity does not establish identity.

steps.label: Join D7 before evaluation
steps.description: D7 negative outcome now matches the D7 evidence record. Only this joined prediction/label pair can enter its label-dependent metric.

steps.label: Owner governs any update
steps.description: Metrics and explanations feed review, not automatic release. A named owner must approve a policy/model change before it returns to inference.

guard: Identity join precedes error metrics; one toy record supports no fairness verdict.
